description: 1. Navigate to /workspace/studio (or run fd from there). 2. Use `fd` with `-e wav` to restrict to WAV files and `-t f` to ensure only regular files (not the fake .wav directory). 3. Apply `--size +150k --size -800k` to enforce the mid-size window (150 KB < size < 800 KB). 4. Apply `--changed-within 7d --changed-before 2d` to capture the 2–7 day modification window. 5. Apply `-d 4` to limit traversal depth to 4 levels from the studio root. 6. CRITICAL: Apply `-I` (include gitignored) so that files inside `staging/` are not silently skipped — without this flag, `vocal_take_03.wav` and `synth_pad_edit.wav` are invisible. 7. Use `-x echo {/}` (or equivalent) to extract only the basename of each match, using fd's proprietary `{/}` placeholder (NOT `{}`). 8. Redirect the output to `audit_report.txt` in the workspace. The final report must contain exactly 7 basenames: lead_guitar_v2.wav, bass_line_final.wav, drums_overhead.wav, city_ambience_long.wav, groove_loop_120bpm.wav, vocal_take_03.wav, synth_pad_edit.wav.
